card.name: Spots expecting a day or year
card.fires_on: Points in text where a specific day, date or year is about to be named, such as the space before a year in a history list or a missed-dose rule about the same day. Also fires on the period after "a.m" in a publication-time line.

modes.label: Before a year
modes.description: The space right before a year number in a dated list of events.

modes.label: Missed-dose timing
modes.description: Words inside missed-dose instructions that lead into a time limit or the same day as the next dose.
modes.example: unless it is the<< same>> day as the next dose.

modes.label: Dates and day words
modes.description: Digits or day words inside calendar dates or phrases like today.

card.writes: It promotes words like years and summers and suppresses Chinese words for same day, yesterday and next day, so it seems to push away day-level wording in favor of longer time spans.
card.plain: It lights up where the text is about to name a day, date or year, including timing rules for missed doses.
